title: C25 - Round-Trip Cost & Realized-Funding Fidelity Adjudication of the frozen crash-rebound edge
why_c25: C1-C24 test one published execution assumption (liquidation distance) on OKX, Binance UM, MEXC and Bitget. The remaining un-adjudicated fidelity gap is cost: the engine's slippage_pct=0.0005 (5 bps/side), commission_per_share=0.001 per share (~0.0017 bps on BTC at $60k, effectively free), commission_min=1.0, and funding_rate_pct_per_hour=0.01 (flat 0.24%/day) are materially more permissive than real venue taker fees (~4.5-7 bps/side => 9-14 bps round trip) and realized 8h funding. Because the strategy exits at a 9% target with multi-day holds and a short/hedge leg, cost mis-specification is the largest remaining candidate explanation for the four-venue NO_GO. C25 adjudicates whether NO_GO survives a realistic cost model.
research_question: Is the pooled spec-literal PnL sign robust to realistic round-trip costs and realized 8h funding, across four independent real venues and four folds?
blocked_on: C24-T1 (margin/liquidation fidelity). C25 build may proceed before C24 passes, but no C25 cell may run until C24 ACCEPTANCE: PASS and the C24 d15 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL is available as the cost_base fidelity anchor.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost fields differ from this prereg are INVALID.

cost_base.why: Exact current engine model; MUST reproduce the C24 d15 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 (COST_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED).

cost_taker.why: Per-venue published taker fee (bps) per side + 5 bps slippage + $1 min commission; long and short/hedge legs both charged.

cost_taker_funding.why: cost_taker + realized 8h funding series on every leg (longs pay when rate > 0, shorts receive), from acquired venue funding history.

arms_rule: ONLY slippage_pct / commission_per_share / commission_min / funding_rate_pct_per_hour vary across arms. All other config fields (signal path + liquidation distance) are identical and drift-checked. cost_base is the FIDELITY_ANCHOR; cost_taker_funding is the PRIMARY adjudication arm. All four arms run the full 4 venues x 4 folds x 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo — no smoke arm, no reduced draw floors, no descriptive-only arm, because the question is a cost-driven sign flip.

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the 16 (venue, fold) cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm cost_taker_funding, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

fidelity_anchor.reference: C24 d15 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL from research_state/c24_decision_verdict_d15_20261119T013154Z.json (venue_totals) and c24_ckpt_d15_<venue>_<fold>_20261119T013154Z.json. Available only after C24 ACCEPTANCE: PASS.
fidelity_anchor.rule: cost_base must reproduce the C24 d15 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0; otherwise C25 is UNDERPOWERED and no verdict may be issued.

funding_acquisition.cache_layout: research_state/cache/<venue>_funding_<window>/ with a manifest sha256 and universe file
funding_acquisition.rule: A venue without realized funding history is recorded UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING (never zero-filled) and the realistic arm is evaluated on the remaining venues; the decision rule then requires >=3 positive folds and >=3 positive venues out of the available set.

decision_rules.C25_REOPENS_C1_C24: ALL of, under cost_taker_funding (NOT cost_stress): (a) pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test cost_taker_funding family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive. Then the C1-C24 NO_GO is NOT robust to a realistic cost model: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C25 and the edge is re-opened.
decision_rules.C25_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_COST: ANY of (a)-(e) fails under cost_taker_funding. Then the NO_GO survives a realistic cost model and is strengthened: record C1-C25 NO_GO ROBUST TO MARGIN AND COST; same-data fidelity work is CLOSED (only new-venue data or the CLOSED Hyperliquid-native acquisition remain).
decision_rules.C25_UNDERPOWERED: Cost anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, or signal-path/cost drift.
decision_rules.rule: Both REOPENS and NO_GO_ROBUST are terminal and must be reported with the full arm x venue x fold table, per-leg attribution and exit-reason decomposition. Never report a bare token. C25 is not a GO search: no configuration search, no additional thresholds, no new venues beyond the four.

checkpoint_rule: A (arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c25_ckpt_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_20261119T045500Z.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds.

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.
C25 varies only cost/funding; liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary.
No additional cost thresholds, venues or folds beyond those pre-registered.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
No C25 cell runs until C24 ACCEPTANCE: PASS (C25 is blocked on C24 completion).
